name: Barney Martin
bio: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia. Barney Martin (March 3, 1923 – March 21, 2005) was an American actor. He is best-known for playing Morty Seinfeld, father of Jerry, on the famous sitcom Seinfeld.
